snapshot.name: ranking_policy_versions
snapshot.sql: SELECT version, effective_at, assessment_weight_bp, performance_weight_bp, recent_standard_match_threshold, algorithm_version, created_by_admin_id, change_note, created_at FROM ranking_policy_versions ORDER BY version

snapshot.name: admin_audit_events
snapshot.sql: SELECT id, actor_admin_id, action, target_type, target_id, source_command_id, occurred_at, metadata, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ranking_policy_versions v WHERE v.id::text = target_id) AS target_is_a_version FROM admin_audit_events ORDER BY action, target_type, source_command_id NULLS FIRST, occurred_at, metadata::text, target_id

snapshot.name: player_notifications
snapshot.sql: SELECT id FROM player_notifications ORDER BY id
